purpose: Fresh primary-source audit for the n=6 public start thresholds; no historical package execution is used as evidence of this read.

sources.title: A remark on the centered n-dimensional Hardy-Littlewood maximal function
actual_read: PDF p.3--4 / print pp.104--105: Lemma 1.1 transfers a finite Dirac-mass lower witness to an L1 function.
PDF p.9 / print p.110: Proposition 1.4 states cn >= the displayed An formula for every n >= 2.
sources.conclusion_used: C6 >= A6; the rational lower endpoint from check_aldaz_n6.py is strictly below A6.

sources.title: Kissing numbers and the centered maximal operator
actual_read: PDF p.2: Theorem 1.2 equates the uniform L1-to-L1,infinity norm over tau-additive locally finite Borel measures to L(X,d).
PDF p.10--11: Theorems 3.2--3.3 identify L(Rd,norm) with the strict Hadwiger number and show attainment by a discrete measure.
PDF p.11: Corollary 3.5 states L(Rd, l_infinity)=2^d and that the uniform bound is attained.
sources.conclusion_used: For Lebesgue measure and axis-parallel cubes, C6 <= 2^6 = 64.

retention: The PDFs are external scratch copies and are not added to the repository; this receipt is the reproducibility record.
